## 🧩 7. `run_pipeline.py` （主流程，含 log）
```python
import sys
import os
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from scripts.case_parser import parse_case
from scripts.draft_generator import generate_draft
from scripts.tts_generator import generate_tts
from scripts.email_report import generate_report
from scripts.document_sender import send_email_backup

LOG_FILE = "logs/legal_ai.log"
logging.basicConfig(
    filename=LOG_FILE,
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
)

def main(case_file: str):
    logging.info("===== Lightning-Legal-AI Pipeline Start =====")
    # 1. 解析原始資料
    logging.info(f"Parsing case file: {case_file}")
    summary = parse_case(case_file)
    logging.info("case_parser done.")
    
    # 2. 生成上訴草稿 Word
    logging.info("Generating appeal draft...")
    generate_draft(summary, case_file)
    logging.info("draft_generator done.")
    
    # 3. 生成語音提醒
    logging.info("Generating TTS reminder...")
    generate_tts(summary)
    logging.info("tts_generator done.")
    
    # 4. 產生 HTML 報告
    logging.info("Generating HTML report...")
    generate_report(summary)
    logging.info("email_report done.")
    
    # 5. Email 備份（若環境變數未設定則跳過）
    logging.info("Attempting email backup...")
    send_email_backup()
    logging.info("Pipeline finished successfully.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        case_path = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        # 若沒給參數，自動抓 cases/ 底下第一個 _raw.txt
        case_dir = "cases"
        files = [f for f in os.listdir(case_dir) if f.endswith("_raw.txt")]
        if not files:
            print("❌ 找不到任何案件原始檔案（cases/*_raw.txt）")
            sys.exit(1)
        case_path = os.path.join(case_dir, files[0])
    main(case_path)
